title: Portal Sherry
summary: Provides 4 Camp Supplies, or can be drunk or thrown for its Alcohol effects.

fields.Camp Supplies: 4 Camp Supplies toward a Long Rest.
fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Applies Alcohol for 2 turns, giving disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks.
fields.Throw: Action. Creates a permanent 13 ft radius Alcohol surface. Fire ignites it and Cold freezes it.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
